description: One image in, a responsive set out: every width in AVIF, WebP and a fallback, a ZIP of the files and a ready <picture> element with srcset, sizes, width and height. Never upscales. Price: $0.02 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Image tools: Everyday image work for sites and apps: convert and compress to WebP/AVIF/JPEG/PNG, responsive srcset sets with ready <picture> markup, colour palettes, pixel diffs for visual regression, SVG to PNG, QR codes, blur placeholders, and an inspection that says what to fix before shipping an image..

basePath.description: Path prefix used in the markup for where you will host the files.

formats.description: Best format first; the last one is the fallback.

image.description: Image file as base64 (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF or SVG).

sizes.description: The sizes attribute for the markup.

widths.description: Widths to produce. Widths above the source are dropped; the source width is added if none fit.

name: image_tools_responsive
